description: Test suite for language hints normalization and filtering functions related to file diff visualization.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters a list of language hints to include only supported ones, falling back to 'text' for unsupported hints.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes the language hints and file diff metadata, converting unsupported or blank hints to 'text' and respecting valid hints.
